comparison.objective: Hang two wine glasses upside down in an overhead channel rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-stem grasp, high-reach end-threading, channel sliding, and gentle release.
comparison.success_condition: One or both glasses stably hang by their feet within alignment/tilt limits; knock-over invalidates credit.
comparison.reason: Fragile-object threading into a rack tests constrained insertion, not bimanual screen manipulation or size/orientation-dependent media flow.
